question: May doctor execute setup code from an explicitly disabled external channel plugin, or must plugin disablement remain an absolute code-execution boundary?
rationale: The branch deliberately enables disabled external owners in a temporary activation config, and repository policy otherwise treats disablement as a loader boundary; choosing the permanent doctor contract requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Preserve disablement
options.body: Use static manifest metadata or a narrowly verified official-owner maintenance contract without generically activating disabled external plugin code.

options.title: Allow scoped doctor execution
options.body: Define and document that doctor may execute setup-only code from disabled installed plugins when a channel is explicitly scoped, while retaining denylist enforcement.

options.title: Split the generic seam
options.body: Land the Signal-local transport work separately and defer disabled external-owner doctor loading to a dedicated security-boundary proposal.

recommendation.title: Preserve disablement
recommendation.body: Use static manifest metadata or a narrowly verified official-owner maintenance contract without generically activating disabled external plugin code.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the proposed Signal migration and the generic disabled-owner doctor-loading design and has the clearest context for narrowing it.
